## The idea

> Generating mobility profiles from National Travel Survey Data and mapping them at small-area level using MRP.

## Steps

1. Use segmentation analysis to generate transport profiles from NTS demographic + behavioural data.
2. Match observations with their mobility profile label.
3. Use MRP to map the spatial distribution of the profiles.

## My understanding

- Survey data must include some geographic indicator.
- I need an outcome of interest, which is the variable to be mapped – in my case, the mobility profile label.
- I need some anchor variables that are both available at survey-level and at census-level (for the target areas).


## Questions

- If I have used the anchor variables (e.g. age, sex, household composition, etc.) as inputs for generating the profile labels, can I then use them as predictors in the MRP model?
